pages.text: Use /hey <name> <action> [arguments]. Named, living, tamed Abyssal Axolotls must belong to you and be nearby (32-block search). Bonded Axoluthu uses a 48-block search. Both require the same dimension.

Abyssal Axolotl actions: follow, sit, stop, protect, fetch_logs. Example: /hey Blueberry fetch_logs 16. Axoluthu: /hey Axoluthu journal or /hey Axoluthu build <building_type>. Point at the intended site and use command suggestions for learned building types.
